entities.summary: Fe'Zahn Tremaine Edmunds is an American professional football linebacker for the New York Giants of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Tech Hokies and was selected by the Buffalo Bills in the first round of the 2018 NFL draft.
